content_sections.heading: NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The District Selection Committee, Mahabubnagar, functioning under the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM&HO), Mahabubnagar District, Telangana, has released NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 Notification No. 02/2026 for recruitment to 9 different post categories under the National Health Mission (NHM) programme. A total of 38 vacancies have been announced, including 15 vacancies for MLHP, 10 vacancies for Staff Nurse and 7 vacancies for Lab Technician, while the remaining posts have 1 vacancy each. The applications are invited through offline mode, and eligible candidates can submit their applications from 22 September 2026 to 26 September 2026 up to 05:00 PM. Download NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Application Form Official Website

content_sections.heading: NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, in terms of Rule-12(1)(a)(v) of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules 1996. The minimum and maximum age is reckoned as on 01.07.2026, subject to the following relaxations for locking the maximum age limit as per rules in force. Note: The Method of Recruitment section separately states that, for the purpose of calculating age-based marks (10 marks out of 100), age is reckoned "as on 01-07-2024," which differs from the 01-07-2026 reckoning date given in the Age clause. Both dates appear as written in the official notification. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

MLHP and Physician MBBS/MD posts carry two remuneration figures (₹40,000/₹29,900 and ₹52,000/₹72,850 respectively); the notification does not specify what distinguishes the two figures for each post.

content_sections.heading: NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made by the District Selection Committee (DSC) on the following basis: Selection is done on merit, based on aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying examination, as per educational guidelines. The Rule of Reservation is followed as per Government Orders in force from time to time. Presidential Order 2018 is followed. A roster is followed for posts with more than one vacancy; the existing roster is continued. Total marks are 100: 90 marks for marks obtained in the qualifying examination, and 10 marks for age (0.5 mark per completed year of age from 18 years, up to a maximum of 10 marks). A merit list is prepared and displayed on the official website of the District Collector, for transparency and for inviting objections. A selection list is then prepared from the finalized merit list, following the Rule of Reservation and Presidential Orders. Selected candidates must maintain their assigned headquarters. Positions are initially filled for one year and are liable to be terminated earlier when regular candidates report for duty, on grounds of poor performance, or for other reasons the Chairman of the District Health Society and District Collector deem fit. Selection is conducted by a District Selection Committee comprising: District Collector - Chairman District Medical & Health Officer - Member-Convener Deputy Director, Social Welfare - Member District Co-ordinator of Hospital Service (DCHS) - Member

Submit the filled application form in person at: O/o DM&HO, Mahabubnagar District, Room No. 201, IDOC Building, Boothpur Road, Mahabubnagar District. Applications are accepted from 22.09.2026 to 26.09.2026, up to 05:00 PM. faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Selection Committee, Mahabubnagar, to fill 38 contract posts under the National Health Mission (NHM) programme, notified vide Notification No. 02/2026, Rc.No.1994/E1&E3/DMHO/MBNR/2026, dated 21.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 38 vacancies are available across nine post categories: Lab Technician (7), MLHP (15), Physician MBBS/MD (1), Staff Nurse (10), Physiotherapist (1), DEIC Manager (1), Pediatrician (1), Pharmacist (1), and Radiographer (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 26.09.2026, up to 05:00 PM. Applications open from 22.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post, ranging from SSC and Intermediate-level paramedical diplomas (Lab Technician, Pharmacist, Radiographer) to MBBS/postgraduate medical degrees (Physician, Pediatrician) and nursing/physiotherapy degrees (Staff Nurse, MLHP, Physiotherapist). See the Qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/BC/EWS candidates, 10 years for physically handicapped candidates, and 3 years for ex-servicemen and NCC-eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹300/- for General candidates and ₹200/- for SC/ST candidates, payable by Demand Draft in favour of the Administrative Officer, O/o DM&HO, Mahabubnagar.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from https://mahabubnagar.telangana.gov.in and submit the filled form in person, along with self-attested documents, at O/o DM&HO, Mahabubnagar District, Room No. 201, IDOC Building, Boothpur Road, Mahabubnagar District. There is no online application mode specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NHM Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit, based on 90 marks from the qualifying examination and 10 marks for age, following the Rule of Reservation and Presidential Order 2018, with a merit list published for objections before finalization.
